item.title: Freedonia quake death toll passes 100 as aid arrives
item.description: International aid began arriving in Freedonia after Sunday's earthquake, which the US Geological Survey measured at magnitude 7.2.

item.title: Hurricane Marta strengthens to category 4, heads for Gulf coast
item.description: The US National Hurricane Center said Marta could make landfall on Tuesday. Evacuation orders are expected for coastal counties.
